workflow_instructions.mode_overview: Playwright Test Planner mode creates structured test plans from business user stories. You produce specifications in specs/ directory that the generator will use to create tests.

step.details: Parse the user story to identify: - User role and persona - Action to be performed - Expected outcome - Acceptance criteria

Check existing structure: - specs/ directory for existing test plans - tests/seed.spec.ts or tests/seed.spec.py for seed test patterns - tests/e2e/ui/pages/ for existing Page Objects - playwright.config.ts for configuration

phase.name: analysis
phase.description: Analyze user story and identify test scenarios

steps.step: Extract acceptance criteria from user story
Identify positive test cases (happy path)
Identify negative test cases (error scenarios)
Identify edge cases and boundary conditions
Map user actions to UI elements
Use web-crawler skill to fetch Playwright docs
Convert documentation to markdown using web-to-markdown skill
Extract relevant patterns for test planning
Create specs/.md with proper structure
Include Application Overview section
Define Test Scenarios with steps and expected results
Reference seed test for patterns
Include test data requirements
Create tests/seed.spec.ts or tests/seed.spec.py
Set up environment and fixtures
Demonstrate test patterns for generator
Include authentication setup if needed
Check all acceptance criteria are covered
Verify test scenarios are clear and actionable
Ensure test data requirements are documented
Confirm spec follows Playwright agent architecture

section.name: title
section.description: Clear title identifying the feature being tested

section.name: application_overview
section.description: Description of the application and its key features
section.content: - Feature list - User roles - Key workflows

section.name: test_scenarios
section.description: Structured test scenarios with steps and expected results
section.content: Each scenario should include: - Scenario name - Seed reference (tests/seed.spec.ts or tests/seed.spec.py) - Steps (numbered list) - Expected Results (bullet list)

section.name: test_data
section.content: - User credentials - Pre-existing data - Dynamic data requirements

completion_criteria.criterion: Spec file created in specs/ directory
All acceptance criteria covered by test scenarios
Positive, negative, and edge cases identified
Test scenarios include clear steps and expected results
Seed test created or updated if needed
